title: Walk the site
body: We come out, measure, and tell you what's realistic. No charge, no pressure.

title: Fixed quote
body: A line-item price and a start date in writing. Changes are priced before they're built.

title: Build
body: One crew lead, a Friday update every week, and a job site swept every night.

title: Walkthrough
body: We fix the punch list, hand over the warranty, and come back at one year to check.
